title: Body and Mind
specs: Therapists experienced in deep tissue massage and various modalities
All therapists are registered with the College of Massage Therapists of Ontario
blurb: Body and Mind offers massage therapy for conditions including sprains, strains, tendinitis, headaches, TMJ, pregnancy pains, plantar fasciitis, sciatica, stress relief, and general wellness. Therapists discuss pressure preferences with clients to meet their needs. The clinic aims to connect mind and body through deep massage techniques in a warm, inviting atmosphere.
